Create ONE standalone full-body first character proposal for AstralPact, portrait composition, a WHITE anthropomorphic rabbit young ADULT woman, the older of two rabbit sisters, daughter of a rabbit mother and tiger father. Tasteful simple clothing with believable weave and seams, no royal jewelry, no tiara. White fur hands with readable anatomy. Plain warm light-grey studio background, soft contact shadow, no text, no other characters. Image 1 is the old male brown rabbit design ONLY for the world's anthropomorphic rabbit anatomy and ordinary-family character language; do NOT copy its brown fur, male identity, hoodie, or childlike proportions. Image 2 is PRIMARY for rendering quality, refined cinematic material and soft lighting ONLY; never borrow dragon anatomy, horns, scales, jewelry, gold embroidery, royal clothing or palace setting. High-end feature-film 3D CGI, physically based materials, individually resolved fine white fur and layered hair, weighty woven fabric with convincing folds, crisp natural detail, soft warm key and subtle cool fill, controlled highlights. Not a human girl wearing bunny ears, not a plush toy, not chibi, no cartoon outlines or paper grain. This is a new unapproved character proposal, not a redesign of the old rabbit.
